201.57(c)(9)(i).note: Content rule for 8.1 Pregnancy in a label of the 201.56(d) format. Sub-paragraphs (A) to (D) are not copied; the text is the (i) paragraph only.

314.70(c)(6)(iii)(A).note: Changes being effected (CBE-0). The subject is 'the applicant' (314.3), which includes an ANDA applicant; 314.97(a) sends the ANDA holder here. Limited by the lead-in to newly acquired information.

314.94(a)(8)(iv).note: Sameness with the reference listed drug at submission, with the listed exceptions.

314.150(b)(10).note: Sameness with the reference listed drug after approval; a discretionary ('may') withdrawal ground, with a hearing. (i) and (ii) are appended to (10).

314.97(a).note: An ANDA holder has 314.70's routes for changes to an approved ANDA.

314.80(c)(1)(i).note: Both conditions, serious and unexpected, are needed. Defined in 314.80(a).

314.80(a)-serious.note: Definition, 314.80(a). The clause id carries a suffix because 314.80(a) holds several definitions.

314.80(a)-unexpected.note: Definition, 314.80(a). 'Unexpected' means not in the current labeling, including greater severity or specificity than a listed event; not 'unanticipated'.

314.98(a).note: Sends the ANDA holder to 314.80 for adverse drug experience reporting.
